text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, El. Heard today's your birthday. 
Happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Thank you so much! So, what about 
you, Sirius-senpai? Don't you have 
something you want to say to El too?!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Something I want to say for your birthday? 
...Not a single thing comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is that a poker face, or are you being 
serious...? El, which one do you think it 
is?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nunuu! No matter how you look at it, that 
was on purpose, desu! Even you knew that, 
Nakayama-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You're gonna have to beg a lot better 
than that, yeah?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Saying that just means you're 
actually blushing, right?! In that case, 
this match goes to El!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What kind of contest is this even supposed 
to be?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First one to blush loses! Come on, come 
on, are you really okay with this!? 
Letting El get away with an easy victory—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, alright, alright. ...If that's the 
case, close your mouth. Your voice will 
reach further that way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“—Happy birthday, El. As for your 
thanks... letting me see your adorable 
bare face is plenty, y'know?”
